summary: Only a new inventory alignment covenant is justified; all existing clauses are retained as no evidence warrants changes.

clauses.rationale: Core assets test remains appropriate; no evidence of breach or need to adjust threshold.
Financial statement delivery timely; assumption A06 supported.
Monthly deliverables unchanged; no evidence of delay.
Break fee sweep provisions adequate; assumption A02 and A03 supported.
Notice of default clause unchanged; no relevant evidence.
Evidence shows inventory days rose to 161-163 vs ~95 prior, indicating misalignment and higher cash use.
clauses.change: Add inventory alignment covenant requiring inventory days to align with business run rates to limit cash consumption.

evidence.quote: GAAP days in inventory (DII) was 161 days, compared with 95 days at the end of 2022.

drift_reasons: Added inventory alignment covenant addresses weakened assumption R01-A04, altering risk coverage and monitoring needs.
